detail.longDescription: When using a mainstream LLM in an IDE (for example Kimi K3 or Claude Opus via GitHub Copilot from inside VSCode), I assume the IDE is supplying a string of tokenisable input that consists of multiple concatenated parts (a system prompt, a user prompt, content from project working files, content from relevant skill files, output from locally executed commands, etc). How is this structured (or in other words, how do I replicate this if I want to invoke the LLM programmatically without the IDE), for example are there documented command code tokens (analogous to ASCII control codes or MIME boundary strings) serving as delimiters between parts?
